prompt: Read text. Trim spaces at both ends, reverse the result, uppercase it, then append 'a'.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.UPPER(strings.REVERSE(strings.TRIM(text," "))),"a")).

prompt: Read text. Lowercase it, replace 'a' with '!', and prefix 'a:'.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE text.
INPUT(text).
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT("a:",strings.REPLACE(strings.LOWER(text),"a","!"))).

prompt: Read left|right text fields. Print LONG1 if the left field is longer, otherwise SHORT1.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
IF (strings.LENGTH(left)>strings.LENGTH(right)) { DISPLAYNL("LONG1"). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL("SHORT1"). }

prompt: Read left|right text fields. Print reversed right, a colon, uppercase left, then 'a'.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
SENTENCE left = parts[0].
SENTENCE right = parts[1].
DISPLAYNL(strings.CONCAT(strings.CONCAT(strings.CONCAT(strings.REVERSE(right),":"),strings.UPPER(left)),"a")).
